_comment: Hades-style evolving dialogue. Lines are raw English (pass through Loc). speaker = deity id, 'narrator' (Ferryman), or 'shade' (hub NPC). trigger = hub|boon|death|victory.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: You are a soul, lost in the lands of the dead.
Six underworlds bar your road to the light.
Cast down the lord of each realm, and the cycle may break.
Death is no ending here. It is only the road. Walk it again.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Another descent awaits. The dead do not rest — and neither shall you.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: The gates stand open, wanderer. Six thrones of death still wait.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: A realm has fallen to you. The other lords take notice.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Realm upon realm lies broken behind you. The light feels nearer now.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: All six lords are vanquished. The cycle... it breaks.
Step into the light, wanderer. You have earned the dawn.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Back so soon? The river always returns the drowned.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Death again. You wear it like a familiar cloak now.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: I have ferried you more times than I can count — yet still you rise. Why?

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: A realm bows to you. The light draws one step nearer.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Another lord cast down. The cycle thins around you, wanderer.

entries.speaker: shade
lines: Another newcomer? Heh. We all think we'll be the one to escape.

entries.speaker: shade
lines: Still here? So am I. Misery loves company, friend.

entries.speaker: shade
lines: You've beaten realms I never reached. Maybe it really is possible...

entries.speaker: shade
lines: You did it. You actually... go. Go, and don't look back.

entries.speaker: greece_zeus
lines: So — a mortal soul dares borrow my thunder. Use it well.

entries.speaker: greece_zeus
lines: Again, Olympus answers you. Do not grow proud.

entries.speaker: greece_zeus
lines: You wield my lightning like an old friend now, little soul.

entries.speaker: greece_athena
lines: Wisdom shields those who think. Bear my aegis.

entries.speaker: greece_athena
lines: You learn. Good — few souls ever do.

entries.speaker: greece_hermes
lines: Quick feet, quicker wit — try to keep up!

entries.speaker: greece_hermes
lines: Still running, little soul? Then run faster.

entries.speaker: greece_ares
lines: Blood and fury! Spill them in my name.

entries.speaker: greece_ares
lines: Yes — again! Let them dread your coming.

entries.speaker: greece_artemis
lines: Aim true. The hunt rewards the patient.

entries.speaker: greece_artemis
lines: A clean shot. The wild is proud of you.

entries.speaker: bali_acintya
lines: All things in balance, traveler. I grant you wholeness.

entries.speaker: bali_acintya
lines: You walk the middle path well.

entries.speaker: bali_barong
lines: Stand firm. My mane will guard you from the dark.

entries.speaker: bali_barong
lines: Rangda's shadow fears you now. Good.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_danu
lines: Drink deep of the lake's life, child.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_danu
lines: The waters remember your face.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_sri
lines: From the rice, abundance. Be nourished.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_sri
lines: You flourish. Carry the harvest onward.

entries.speaker: bali_batara_kala
lines: All falls to ruin in time. Borrow my hunger.

entries.speaker: bali_batara_kala
lines: Time devours all — but not you. Not yet.

entries.speaker: egypt_ra
lines: The sun's fire is yours. Burn away the dark.

entries.speaker: egypt_ra
lines: You blaze brightly, mortal. Take care you are not consumed.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: Death is not the end. Endure, and live.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: Risen again. The Duat cannot keep you.

entries.speaker: egypt_anubis
lines: I weigh every heart. Yours is heavy with resolve.

entries.speaker: egypt_anubis
lines: Send them to me. I will judge what remains.

entries.speaker: egypt_horus
lines: Strike like the falcon — swift and sure.

entries.speaker: egypt_horus
lines: Your eye is keen now. Strike.

entries.speaker: egypt_set
lines: Chaos is power, if you dare to wield it.

entries.speaker: egypt_set
lines: Reckless? Yes. Effective? Also yes.

entries.speaker: egypt_sekhmet
lines: Roar, little lion. Bathe in their blood.

entries.speaker: egypt_sekhmet
lines: The lioness is pleased. Hunt on.

entries.speaker: norse_odin
lines: Knowledge has a price. Pay it, and grow wise.

entries.speaker: norse_odin
lines: The runes whisper your name in the halls of the slain.

entries.speaker: norse_thor
lines: Swing as I do — let nothing stand!

entries.speaker: norse_thor
lines: HA! Again! Crush them, friend!

entries.speaker: norse_freyja
lines: Beauty and war are one. Take my seidr.

entries.speaker: norse_freyja
lines: You please me. The fallen will be yours to claim.

entries.speaker: norse_tyr
lines: Hold the line, even at cost. That is honor.

entries.speaker: norse_tyr
lines: Steadfast. Few keep their oath as you do.

entries.speaker: norse_heimdall
lines: I see all roads. Walk yours with open eyes.

entries.speaker: norse_heimdall
lines: Nothing surprises you now. Stay watchful.

entries.speaker: norse_loki
lines: Oh, this will be fun. Take a little chaos, friend.

entries.speaker: norse_loki
lines: Back again? You and I, we understand each other.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: Let my light drive back the shadows of Yomi.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: You shine, even here in the dark. Beautiful.

entries.speaker: japan_susanoo
lines: Ride the storm! Let the seas rage with you.

entries.speaker: japan_susanoo
lines: The tempest knows you now. Good.

entries.speaker: japan_raijin
lines: Thunder answers the bold. Take it.

entries.speaker: japan_raijin
lines: BOOM! Louder each time, little one!

entries.speaker: japan_fujin
lines: Swift as the wind — go, before they blink.

entries.speaker: japan_fujin
lines: You move like a gale now.

entries.speaker: japan_tsukuyomi
lines: Strike from the moonlit shadow.

entries.speaker: japan_tsukuyomi
lines: The night hides you well, hunter.

entries.speaker: japan_inari
lines: Fox-fire and fortune favor the clever.

entries.speaker: japan_inari
lines: The fox smiles on you. Be cunning.

entries.speaker: aztec_huitzilopochtli
lines: War feeds the sun. Fight, and let it rise.

entries.speaker: aztec_huitzilopochtli
lines: The sun burns hotter for your battles.

entries.speaker: aztec_quetzalcoatl
lines: Ride the feathered wind, wise one.

entries.speaker: aztec_quetzalcoatl
lines: You learn the old wisdom. Soar.

entries.speaker: aztec_tlaloc
lines: Let the storm-rain fall upon your foes.

entries.speaker: aztec_tlaloc
lines: The rains come when you call now.

entries.speaker: aztec_tezcatlipoca
lines: Look into the smoking mirror... and take what you see.

entries.speaker: aztec_tezcatlipoca
lines: Trickster to trickster — well played.

entries.speaker: aztec_mictlantecuhtli
lines: All roads end in Mictlan. I lend you death's hand.

entries.speaker: aztec_mictlantecuhtli
lines: You send many to my realm. I remember each.

entries.speaker: aztec_xochipilli
lines: Feast, dance, bloom! Even the dead may live.

entries.speaker: aztec_xochipilli
lines: You flourish in the dark. How delightful.
